title: Voice notes into structured entries
sub: One fixed transcription call, then a fixed split-and-fill sequence. No step chooses what happens next.

steps.d:
audio, 41 seconds. Code calls the transcription
model once; this call was never in question.

steps.h: The model returns a transcript; code splits it
steps.d:
"...belt's worn and needs replacing before next
visit, also the condensate line has a slow drip
near the drain pan." → 2 candidate findings

steps.h: Code sends finding 1 to the model with the fixed schema
steps.d:
location: rooftop unit · component: drive belt
condition: worn · action: ?

action: "replace before next visit" · confidence: high
all required fields present.

steps.h: Code sends finding 2 to the model
steps.d:
location: rooftop unit · component: condensate line
condition: slow drip near drain pan · action: ?

location, component and condition present.
action: not stated · confidence: low, flagged for review
rather than filed as routine.

steps.h: Code writes both records to the queue
steps.d:
2 records filed. 1 flagged for a person to add
the missing action before it is scheduled.
